ValidationRule.description: Prevents closing GM Monetary Claim cases without Accounting Date or SIRO Account.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'SER_GM_User', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'SER_Closed_Case_GM_User' ), SER_Incident_with_economic_impact__c, OR( ISNULL(SER_Accounting_date__c), ISPICKVAL(SER_SIRO_Account__c, "") ), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Accounting Date and SIRO Account are mandatory to close GM Monetary Claim cases.
